result.reason: The operative clause reaches the preferred limits for CGL, E&O, cyber coverage for a data-processing vendor, workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. It preserves the force majeure provision and unrelated commercial intent. However, requiring every policy to remain in force for one year after the Agreement ends exceeds the playbook and is not well tailored, particularly for workers’ compensation and occurrence-based CGL coverage. The cyber provision would also be clearer if it expressly referenced privacy liability.
